hardRules: Do not merge the historical L27 branch wholesale into the current runtime.
Do not merge Foundation L10 into this recovery lane until reconciliation gates explicitly admit it.
Preserve the current Foundation V2 L9 identity model and Russian runtime behavior.
Preserve offline behavior and packaged ChatGPT Site behavior.
Keep Roadmap V2 production-disconnected until a dedicated activation round passes.
Every recovery round must pass its own gate before the next round starts.

rounds.name: Baseline freeze and source-of-truth recovery
rounds.goal: Pin modern runtime, historical Roadmap terminal state, and protected boundaries.

rounds.name: Non-runtime Roadmap transplant
rounds.goal: Transplant isolated Roadmap V2 contracts, data, tools, tests and evidence without wiring production UI/runtime.

rounds.name: Modern-baseline regeneration and drift audit
rounds.goal: Regenerate inventories and detect ID, fingerprint, source and prerequisite drift against current main.

rounds.name: Foundation and Russian compatibility bridge
rounds.goal: Reconcile Roadmap identities/evidence with Foundation V2 L9 and current Russian capability/evidence contracts.

rounds.name: Offline, package and failure-mode hardening
rounds.goal: Validate browser offline, reload, package materialization, tamper and rollback behavior with the reconciled Roadmap present.

rounds.name: Full promotion gate
rounds.goal: Run combined Roadmap, Foundation, Russian, Math, Hub and packaged browser gates; freeze the reconciled baseline.
